arxiv-2109-13792.title: Cluster Synchronization of Networks via a Canonical Transformation for Simultaneous Block Diagonalization of Matrices
arxiv-2109-13792.creator: Shirin Panahi, Isaac Klickstein, Francesco Sorrentino
arxiv-2109-13792.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shirin Panahi, Isaac Klickstein, Francesco Sorrentino. We study cluster synchronization of networks and propose a canonical transformation for simultaneous block diagonalization of matrices that we use to analyze stability of the cluster synchronous solution.

arxiv-2205-15810.title: The maximum number of copies of an even cycle in a planar graph
arxiv-2205-15810.creator: Zequn Lv, Ervin Győri, Zhen He, Nika Salia, Casey Tompkins, Xiutao Zhu
arxiv-2205-15810.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zequn Lv, Ervin Győri, Zhen He, Nika Salia, Casey Tompkins, Xiutao Zhu. We resolve a conjecture of Cox and Martin by determining asymptotically for every k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 the maximum number of copies of C 2 ​ k C_{2k} in an n n -vertex planar graph. 1
Introduction

A fundamental problem in extremal combinatorics is maximizing the number of occurrences of subgraphs of a certain type among all graphs from a given class.

arxiv-2206-14102.title: Korovkin type theorems for weakly nonlinear and monotone operators
arxiv-2206-14102.creator: Sorin G. Gal, Constantin P. Niculescu
arxiv-2206-14102.description: Abstract . In this paper we prove analogues of Korovkin’s theorem in the context of weakly nonlinear and monotone operators acting on Banach lattices of functions of several variables. Our results concern the convergence almost everywhere, the convergence in measure and the convergence in L p L^{p} -norm. Several results illustrating the theory are also included.

arxiv-2207-00472.title: Modulational instability and quantum droplets in a two-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensate
arxiv-2207-00472.creator: Sherzod R. Otajonov, Eduard N. Tsoy, Fatkhulla Kh. Abdullaev
arxiv-2207-00472.description: Abstract Modulational instability of a uniform two-dimensional binary Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) in the presence of quantum fluctuations is studied. The analysis is based on the coupled Gross-Pitaevskii equations. It is shown that quantum fluctuations can induce instability when the BEC density is below a threshold. The dependence of the growth rate of modulations on the BEC parameters is found.

arxiv-2302-03608.title: Online Reinforcement Learning with Uncertain Episode Lengths
arxiv-2302-03608.creator: Debmalya Mandal, Goran Radanović, Jiarui Gan, Adish Singla, Rupak Majumdar
arxiv-2302-03608.description: Abstract Existing episodic reinforcement algorithms assume that the length of an episode is fixed across time and known a priori. In this paper, we consider a general framework of episodic reinforcement learning when the length of each episode is drawn from a distribution.

arxiv-2304-01565.title: A Survey on Graph Diffusion Models: Generative AI in Science for Molecule, Protein and Material
arxiv-2304-01565.creator: Mengchun Zhang*, Maryam Qamar*, Taegoo Kang, Yuna Jung, Chenshuang Zhang, Sung-Ho Bae † \dagger, Chaoning Zhang † \dagger
arxiv-2304-01565.description: Abstract Diffusion models have become a new SOTA generative modeling method in various fields, for which there are multiple survey works that provide an overall survey. With the number of articles on diffusion models increasing exponentially in the past few years, there is an increasing need for survey of diffusion models on specific fields.

arxiv-2406-03539.title: Astrometric Search for Ultralight Dark Matter
arxiv-2406-03539.creator: Hyungjin Kim
arxiv-2406-03539.description: Abstract Precision astrometry offers a way to probe new physics. By measuring the angular position of light sources at unprecedented precision, astrometry could probe minuscule fluctuations of underlying spacetime. This work explores the possibility of probing ultralight dark matter candidates using precision astrometry.

arxiv-2507-03122.title: Federated Learning for ICD Classification with Lightweight Models and Pretrained Embeddings
arxiv-2507-03122.creator: Binbin XU, Gérard DRAY
arxiv-2507-03122.description: Abstract This study investigates the feasibility and performance of federated learning (FL) for multi-label ICD code classification using clinical notes from the MIMIC-IV dataset. Unlike previous approaches that rely on centralized training or fine-tuned large language models, we propose a lightweight and scalable pipeline combining frozen text embeddings with simple multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifiers.

arxiv-2512-06952.title: Resource-Bounded Type Theory: Compositional Cost Analysis via Graded Modalities
arxiv-2512-06952.creator: Mirco A. Mannucci, Corey Thuro
arxiv-2512-06952.description: Abstract We present a compositional framework for certifying resource bounds in typed programs. Terms are typed with synthesized bounds 𝖻 \mathsf{b} drawn from an abstract resource lattice ( L , ⪯ , ⊕ , ⊔ , ⊥ ) (L,\preceq,\oplus,\sqcup,\bot) , enabling uniform treatment of time, memory, gas, and domain-specific costs.

pmc-10542362.creator: Unknown
pmc-10542362.description: Today, Communications Chemistry launches a series of Q&A articles conducted with queer chemists. Diamond-like carbon (DLC) is an ideal coating for implants as they are wear-resistant, corrosion-resistant, inert, and have a low friction coefficient.

pmc-11691515.creator: Mariam Kirvalidze, Anne-Marie Boström, Anne Liljas, Megan Doheny, Anne Hendry, Brendan McCormack, Janne Agerholm, Amaia Calderón-Larrañaga
pmc-11691515.description: The recent shift towards a holistic, person-centered approach to older people’s care that considers a person’s overall well-being requires collaboration within and between medical and social healthcare organizations. Publications were identified by searching MEDLINE and contacting experts.

pmc-12651444.title: Association Between Metabolic Syndrome and Risk of Laryngeal Cancer: A Systematic Review
pmc-12651444.creator: Faizan Bashir, Supriya Peshin, Moniza Rafiq, Sajida Zaiter, Naga Anvesh Kodali, Helia Bazroodi, Moiza Bashir, Lalith Vardhan Choudary, Sakshi Singal
pmc-12651444.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryThis review looked at whether metabolic syndrome (MetS), a cluster of conditions like high blood pressure, high blood sugar, and abdominal obesity, is linked to laryngeal cancer. After searching major databases, five large studies were included. Three studies from Korea showed that people with MetS had a higher risk of developing laryngeal cancer, even after accounting for smoking and alcohol use. High blood pressure and blood sugar were the most common factors tied to increased risk.

pmc-13180653.title: Testosterone treatment for micropenis in partial androgen insensitivity syndrome
pmc-13180653.creator: Marie Shuto, Tomoyo Itonaga, Fumika Matsuda, Miwako Maeda, Noriko Oyama, Kenji Ihara
pmc-13180653.description: The optimal approach to hormonal treatment aimed at increasing penis size has been established for infant males with micropenis; however, data are limited in partial androgen insensitivity syndrome (PAIS). We report a 6-month-old male patient treated with intramuscular testosterone for micropenis. At birth, he presented with atypical genitalia, including a microphallus, hypospadias, and a bifid scrotum.

pmc-13559440.title: Epidemiology, risk factors and clinical outcomes of multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa colonization in bronchiectasis: a territory-wide study in Hong Kong
pmc-13559440.creator: Zhiling Yuan, Long Kiu Tsang, James Chung Man Ho, Ivan Fan Ngai Hung, Wang Chun Kwok
pmc-13559440.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMultidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa (MDR-PA) is a common colonizer in bronchiectasis patients, associated with worse clinical outcomes. This study aimed to investigate the epidemiology, risk factors, and clinical impacts of MDR-PA colonization among bronchiectasis patients in Hong Kong.MethodsThis territory-wide retrospective cohort study included adult bronchiectasis patients colonized with Pseudomonas aeruginosa from 2014 to 2023 using the Clinical Data Analysis and Reporting System (CDARS) of the Hospital Authority, Hong Kong. MDR-PA prevalence and associated factors were analyzed.
